title: Qualifying service and retirement pension
text: An employee who completes ten years of qualifying service may receive retirement pension. Qualifying service excludes unauthorised absence.

title: Family pension for dependants
text: Family pension may be paid to an eligible spouse or dependent child after the death of a pensioner.

title: Commutation of pension
text: A pensioner may commute a permitted portion of pension. Commutation value uses the prescribed age factor and pension amount.

title: Revision of pension benefits
text: Pension revision is governed by the applicable government circular. Revised benefits apply from the effective date.

title: Break in qualifying service
text: A break in service may affect qualifying service. A competent authority may condone an eligible break.

title: Dependent family member
text: A dependent family member may qualify for family pension subject to age, income and relationship conditions.

title: Retirement date and revised scheme
text: The revised pension scheme applies to employees retiring on or after its effective date.

title: Service record verification
text: The department verifies appointment date, retirement date, service periods and breaks before calculating qualifying service.
